Communication and Collaboration

How can I participate in a community of practice?

Short Answer

Contribute useful knowledge, ask questions and respect community guidelines when sharing ideas and resources online.

Detailed Guidance

Find a community relevant to your work, read its participation and privacy expectations, and introduce a question or experience that others can learn from. Share useful resources with context, acknowledge contributors and follow up on ideas you apply.
